title: Read through a cache
description: Step through one read, from the client's request to its response.

frames.label: Request
frames.caption: The client sends a read to the API.

frames.label: Check cache
frames.caption: The API checks the cache first.

frames.label: Cache miss
frames.caption: The cache misses, so the read goes on to the database.

frames.label: Database
frames.caption: The database returns the row, and the cache keeps a copy.
